_comment: Project-level policy for the /pb-review skill bundle. Pre-approves the MCP tools that pb-context-build / /pb-review / pb-apply-plan need to operate without per-call permission prompts. Read-only and session-setup tools only; anything that writes a .pbl or builds an artifact stays subject to interactive confirmation. Snapshotted to consumer projects by scripts/sync-skills.ps1 — modifications happen in pb-ai-code, not in the consumer.
